</div></div><div class="g-cols wpb_row us_custom_67001e76 via_grid cols_3-1 laptops-cols_inherit tablets-cols_inherit mobiles-cols_1 valign_top type_default stacking_default" style="--columns-gap:3rem;"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="w-iconbox us_custom_007a6d00 iconpos_left style_default color_primary align_left no_text"><div class="w-iconbox-icon" style="font-size:2rem;"><i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i></div><div class="w-iconbox-meta"><p class="w-iconbox-title">DESCRIPTION</p></div></div><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_a1cb74cc"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p>Ready to kitesurf in paradise? Join Australia&#8217;s ONLY dedicated kitesurfing tour company for an all-inclusive experience in the beautiful Cocos (Keeling) Islands. As the sole kite school in the Cocos Islands with a support and rescue boat and a staff-to-guest ratio of 1:2, you can be assured you&#8217;ll be well taken care of. Relax in our exclusive-use kite centre, enjoy delicious meals at the beachside, and fast-track your progression by choosing Zephyr Tours for your kitesurfing holiday.</p>
<p><strong>WANT TO KNOW WHAT&#8217;S INCLUDED?</strong> Check out the tour inclusions on our <a title="Cocos Islands" href="https://www.zephyrkitetours.com/cocos-islands-2/">Cocos Progression Tour</a> page.</p>
<p><strong>HAVE ANY QUESTIONS?</strong> Check out our <a title="FAQs" href="https://www.zephyrkitetours.com/faqs/">FAQs</a>, or send us a message <a title="Contact Us" href="https://www.zephyrkitetours.com/contact-us-2/">here</a>.</p>
</div></div><div class="w-iconbox us_custom_be7c92dc iconpos_left style_default color_primary align_left no_text"><div class="w-iconbox-icon" style="font-size:2rem;"><i class="fas fa-dollar"></i></div><div class="w-iconbox-meta"><p class="w-iconbox-title">PRICING</p></div></div><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_4f417ca5"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p>In 2025, we introduced a new pricing structure for our Cocos (Keeling) Islands kiteboarding tour packages. We now offer two distinct packages: a <strong>Beginner</strong> Kite Lesson package for those who are complete beginners or have had only a few lessons but aren&#8217;t yet confident in riding, and an <strong>Experienced</strong> Kiter package for those already able to kite. Descriptions of each package are provided below. If you&#8217;re unsure which option is right for you, <span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0px; padding: 0px;">please don&#8217;t hesitate to call or email us—our contact details can be found on the <a href="https://www.zephyrkitetours.com/contact-us-2/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">&#8216;Contact Us&#8217;</a></span> page.</p>
</div></div><div class="w-iconbox us_custom_f5cf9db3 iconpos_left style_default color_primary align_left no_text"><div class="w-iconbox-icon" style="font-size:2rem;"><i class="fas fa-layer-group"></i></div><div class="w-iconbox-meta"><p class="w-iconbox-title">KITING LEVELS</p></div></div><div class="aio-icon-component    style_1"><div id="Info-box-wrap-2943" class="aio-icon-box left-icon" style=""  ><div class="aio-icon-left"><div class="ult-just-icon-wrapper  "><div class="align-icon" style="text-align:center;">

</div></div></div></div><div class="aio-ibd-block"><div class="aio-icon-header" ><h3 class="aio-icon-title ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='#Info-box-wrap-2943 .aio-icon-title'  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}'  style="font-family:&#039;Oswald&#039;;color:#676f7c;">BEGINNER</h3></div> <div class="aio-icon-description ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='#Info-box-wrap-2943 .aio-icon-description'  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}'  style="">You are considered a <strong>BEGINNER KITER</strong> if you:</p>
<ul>
<li>Have never previously flown a kite</li>
<li>Have attempted board starts and not yet been successful</li>
<li>Have done less than 2 hours on the board</li>
</ul>
</div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="aio-icon-component    style_1"><div id="Info-box-wrap-7484" class="aio-icon-box left-icon" style=""  ><div class="aio-icon-left"><div class="ult-just-icon-wrapper  "><div class="align-icon" style="text-align:center;">

</div></div></div></div><div class="aio-ibd-block"><div class="aio-icon-header" ><h3 class="aio-icon-title ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='#Info-box-wrap-7484 .aio-icon-title'  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}'  style="font-family:&#039;Oswald&#039;;color:#676f7c;">EXPERIENCED</h3></div> <div class="aio-icon-description ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='#Info-box-wrap-7484 .aio-icon-description'  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}'  style="">You are considered an <strong>EXPERIENCED</strong> kiter if you can:</p>
<ul>
<li>Launch &amp; land the kite safely</li>
<li>Kite independently without continued instruction</li>
<li>Do prolonged runs in both directions</li>
</ul>

</div></div><div class="g-cols wpb_row us_custom_2e605341 via_grid cols_3-1 laptops-cols_inherit tablets-cols_inherit mobiles-cols_1 valign_top type_default stacking_default" style="--columns-gap:3rem;"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="w-iconbox us_custom_007a6d00 iconpos_left style_default color_primary align_left no_text"><div class="w-iconbox-icon" style="font-size:2rem;"><i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i></div><div class="w-iconbox-meta"><p class="w-iconbox-title">DESCRIPTION</p></div></div><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_a1cb74cc"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p>Are you prepared for an epic off-road kitesurfing adventure? Join Zephyr for exclusive access to some of Western Australia&#8217;s finest flat-water kite spots in Ningaloo Reef, all set against the stunning backdrop of Cape Range National Park. Based in Exmouth, we will explore a different amazing kite location by 4&#215;4 each day, supported by our committed kite coaches and a full-time rescue vessel, ensuring your progression and safety are our top priorities. Relish a catered lunch and unwind at our fully-equipped mobile kite centre, with everything you need right at your fingertips.</p>
<p><strong>WANT TO KNOW WHAT&#8217;S INCLUDED?</strong> Check out the tour inclusions on our <a title="The Western Australia Remote Kiteboarding Tour" href="https://www.zephyrkitetours.com/western-australia-kiteboarding-tour/">W.A. Remote Off-road Tour</a> page.</p>

Tour is suitable for experienced kiters only. For this adventure, you must be able to ride upwind; as we will be kiting in off-shore locations, it is essential you are able to return to shore. If you would like to know whether you are a good fit for this tour, please contact us <a href="https://www.zephyrkitetours.com/contact-us-2/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">here</a>.</p>

You can learn in a safe and supportive environment with experienced and patient instructors who will customise lessons to meet your individual needs. Phil, a local resident who lives on the island year-round, conducts all our beginner kite lessons. You can choose from our lesson packages of 2, 5, or 10 hours.</p>
<p>For more information about our <strong>kite lessons</strong> and<strong> package options</strong>, click <a href="https://www.zephyrkitetours.com/kite-lessons-cocos-keeling-islands/">here</a>.</p>
</div></div><div class="w-iconbox us_custom_e6866c0e has_text_color iconpos_left style_default color_primary align_left no_text"><div class="w-iconbox-icon" style="font-size:1rem;"><i class="fas fa-calendar"></i></div><div class="w-iconbox-meta"><p class="w-iconbox-title">DATES</p></div></div><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_f1bdabef"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p><strong>May to October for the best winds</strong></p>
</div></div><div class="w-iconbox us_custom_37763bf1 has_text_color iconpos_left style_default color_primary align_left no_text"><div class="w-iconbox-icon" style="font-size:1rem;"><i class="fas fa-layer-group"></i></div><div class="w-iconbox-meta"><p class="w-iconbox-title">KITING LEVELS</p></div></div><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_f1bdabef"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p>We offer beginner to intermediate lessons year-round, with advanced coaching available from July to September, led by the Stoke Coach, Ben Strowger.</p>
</div></div><div class="w-iconbox us_custom_e6866c0e has_text_color iconpos_left style_default color_primary align_left no_text"><div class="w-iconbox-icon" style="font-size:1rem;"><i class="fas fa-clipboard-check"></i></div><div class="w-iconbox-meta"><p class="w-iconbox-title">BOOK HERE</p></div></div><div class="wpb_text_column"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p><strong>To book your kite lesson or coaching session:</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>Use the calendar picker to select the start date of your desired package or lesson.</li>
<li>If you don’t see any availability for your preferred date, try scrolling forward on the calendar to find more options.</li>

<p><strong>PLEASE NOTE:</strong> You won&#8217;t be charged when you book. Payment is due two days prior to your scheduled lesson. After booking, we will contact you with more information.</p>

</div></div><div class="g-cols wpb_row us_custom_2e605341 via_grid cols_3-1 laptops-cols_inherit tablets-cols_inherit mobiles-cols_1 valign_top type_default stacking_default" style="--columns-gap:3rem;"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="w-iconbox us_custom_007a6d00 iconpos_left style_default color_primary align_left no_text"><div class="w-iconbox-icon" style="font-size:2rem;"><i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i></div><div class="w-iconbox-meta"><p class="w-iconbox-title">DESCRIPTION</p></div></div><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_a1cb74cc"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p>Are you prepared for an epic off-road kitesurfing adventure? Join Zephyr for exclusive access to some of Western Australia&#8217;s finest flat-water kite spots in Ningaloo Reef, all set against the stunning backdrop of Cape Range National Park. Based in Exmouth, we will explore a different amazing kite location by 4&#215;4 each day, supported by our committed kite coaches and a full-time rescue vessel, ensuring your progression and safety are our top priorities. Relish a catered lunch and unwind at our fully-equipped mobile kite centre, with everything you need right at your fingertips.</p>
<p><strong>WANT TO KNOW WHAT&#8217;S INCLUDED?</strong> Check out the tour inclusions on our <a title="The Western Australia Remote Kiteboarding Tour" href="https://www.zephyrkitetours.com/western-australia-kiteboarding-tour/">W.A. Remote Off-road Tour</a> page.</p>
<p><strong>HAVE ANY QUESTIONS?</strong> Check out our <a title="FAQs" href="https://www.zephyrkitetours.com/faqs/">FAQs</a>, or send us a message <a title="Contact Us" href="https://www.zephyrkitetours.com/contact-us-2/">here</a>.</p>
</div></div><div class="w-iconbox us_custom_be7c92dc iconpos_left style_default color_primary align_left no_text"><div class="w-iconbox-icon" style="font-size:2rem;"><i class="fas fa-layer-group"></i></div><div class="w-iconbox-meta"><p class="w-iconbox-title">KITING LEVELS</p></div></div><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_a1cb74cc"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p>Our W.A. Tour is suitable for experienced kiters only. For this adventure, you must be able to ride upwind; as we will be kiting in off-shore locations, it is essential you are able to return to shore. If you would like to know whether you are a good fit for this tour, please contact us <a href="https://www.zephyrkitetours.com/contact-us-2/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">here</a>.</p>
</div></div><div class="w-iconbox us_custom_6f8cc523 iconpos_left style_default color_primary align_left no_text"><div class="w-iconbox-icon" style="font-size:2rem;"><i class="fas fa-tshirt"></i></div><div class="w-iconbox-meta"><p class="w-iconbox-title">MERCHANDISE</p></div></div><div class="wpb_text_column us_custom_703b2333"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><p>Want to rock the latest Zephyr merchandise? Pre-order during your booking process to guarantee you&#8217;ll receive the coolest Zephyr gear, personally delivered to you while you&#8217;re on tour!</p>
<p>You will have the opportunity to include the Zephyr Merch pack when finalising your booking.</p>

<p><strong>NOTE:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>You will not be charged at the time of booking.</strong> A deposit is required within 7 days to secure your spot.</li>

Phil, a local resident who lives on the island year-round, conducts all our beginner kite lessons. You can choose from our lesson packages of 2, 5, or 10 hours.</p>
